selection: First 20 companies in Supabase companies table, ID ascending; frozen IDs
policy: Only confirmed exact core-system dates feed workday_signal_date. Month/year windows, module expansions, upper bounds, plans, durations and customer announcements remain explicitly labelled in timing evidence. No scoring rules changed.

database_detection_note.reason: Public page describes domain-level detection, which may cover a single storefront and misses authenticated deployments. Detection/first-recorded dates are observations, not actual implementation dates.

companies.reason: ADP’s 2024 case study reports three years of global Workday use, but the interview date is not stated. This confirms historical operation, not an exact 2021 launch.

companies.company_name: St John of God Health Care
companies.reason: Employer modern-slavery statement describes Workday LMS training during its 2024 review period. Learning was in use during 2024; this is not its launch date or an exact HCM go-live.

companies.reason: Official customer story describes an eight-month implementation, without a calendar start or go-live date. No additional dated launch found in the reviewed public sources.

companies.reason: Workday customer story confirms operational time tracking but does not date go-live. Secondary purchase-year claims do not establish the global HCM launch.

companies.reason: Jardines’ February 15, 2020 announcement describes an already-completed rollout to more than 400 head-office colleagues. This is an upper bound, not the launch day or proof of group-wide deployment.

companies.reason: Workday’s interview with implementation leader Danielle Sullivan explicitly dates Finance/capital-projects go-live to January 2021. No day is stated; unrelated Health Research Inc RFP dates were excluded.
